title: obsidian-mission-lock input envelope
description: Envelope passed by the Obsidian controller when invoking the skill. Custom project convention (Obsidian Plan), version 1.0.0.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier (UUID/ULID), generated by the controller

context.description: Free-form context. Reserved keys: draft_contract (a contract object for programmatic checking), pathway, matrix (MICP domain)

evidence_refs.description: URIs/paths/DOIs of evidence the mission may cite

skill_version.description: Skill version the caller expects; cross-major mismatch without migration is rejected (OML-E1010)

prior_contract.description: Previous locked contract when this is a revision request
